Generate Your Attendance QR Code

Each event has its own QR code. A QR created for one event cannot be used for another event.

Select the exact event, then generate the QR code. Moderators will scan this event-specific QR to record your attendance.

Your QR code is valid for 24 hours from generation. You can generate it ahead of time or the night before the event.

Select an event above, then click "Generate QR Code"
